mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequently to higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above a 5% month-over-month growth rate signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 5% does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 70% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which may lead to negative economic growth expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong job growth, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 70% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS QoQ > GDPC1 QoQ does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight monetary policy in a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
